verdict.rationale: Zero's first-party MCP server documents 'Bulk archive emails' and 'Bulk delete emails', plus 'Modify email labels' and 'Mark emails as read/unread'. That is a genuine bulk-triage capability of the product, but it is exposed only as agent/MCP tools; nothing shows a user selecting many conversations in the inbox UI. missing for 10: in-app multi-select of conversations, a one-stroke bulk label action, a 'mark done' action, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk triage in the client.
